title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for E_gamma - B.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of energy conservation principles in the context of the reaction.

title: Lorentz Invariance
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the concept of Lorentz invariance to relate energies and momenta.

title: Binding Energy Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The student should correctly define the binding energy B in relation to the masses involved.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should justify the approximation B << Mc^2 used in the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the final expression.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms are consistent in units throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or implications of the derived expression.
